name: PackDouble
evidence: packs a double taken apart (kind, sign, exponent, fraction) back into its 64 bits, rounding and handling NaN, zero, infinity and denormals (soft_float.c)

name: UnpackDouble
evidence: takes a double's 64 bits apart into kind, sign, unbiased exponent and fraction (every operation of soft_float.c starts with it)

name: AddUnpackedDoubles
evidence: adds two unpacked doubles, aligning their exponents and handling the special kinds (the double add and subtract call it)

name: DivideDoubles
evidence: unpacks two doubles, divides them and packs the result (FormatExponent calls it)

name: CompareUnpackedDoubles
evidence: compares two unpacked doubles by kind, sign, exponent and fraction (the double comparison calls it)

name: ConvertDoubleToS32
evidence: converts a double to a signed 32-bit integer, 0 for NaN and zero, saturating at the limits

name: ConvertDoubleToU32
evidence: converts a double to an unsigned 32-bit integer, 0 for negative values and NaN, 0xFFFFFFFF above the range

name: PackDoubleFromParts
evidence: packs a double from a kind, sign, exponent and fraction passed as loose arguments (fptodp, func_001FD868, calls it)
